stem.text: Ethanal reacts with hydrogen cyanide in the presence of $\text{KCN}$ to produce a hydroxynitrile.
What is the first step in the mechanism of this reaction?

A.alt: Ethanal with delta-minus O and delta-plus C; a curly arrow from the C=O bond to CN- (no lone pair shown on CN-).

B.alt: Ethanal with delta-minus O and delta-plus C; a curly arrow from the C=O bond to O; a curly arrow from the lone pair of :CN- to the carbonyl carbon.

C.alt: Ethanal with delta-minus O and delta-plus C; a curly arrow from the C=O bond to O; a curly arrow from a lone pair of CN- (two lone pairs shown) to the carbonyl carbon.

D.alt: Ethanal with delta-minus O and delta-plus C; a curly arrow from the C=O bond to H+.
